# MM-P2-L4-HT02 - Maintenance manual - Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P2, line P2-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L4-HT02

## Scope
This document covers routine maintenance and verification tasks for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02). It applies to operations and maintenance personnel responsible for safe operation and process control within line P2-L4. See SB-1016 for safety bulletin and hazards.

## Tools
- Calibrated thermocouple simulator
- Standard electrical hand tools per site kit
- Insulation inspection mirror
- Data logger compatible with furnace output
Refer to SOP-P2-L4-02 and SOP-P2-L4-03 for permitted tool lists and PPE requirements.

## Procedure
1. Verify lockout/tagout in accordance with SB-1016 before any access to EQ-P2-L4-HT02.
2. Visually inspect chamber interior and heating elements for damage. Record findings in maintenance log referenced in SOP-P2-L4-02.
3. Confirm control setpoint: The austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02) is 885 °C. Do not adjust without authorization from heat treat engineer per SOP-P2-L4-03.
4. Validate thermocouple response using the calibrated thermocouple simulator. Compare simulator output to furnace controller readout and document variance in the calibration section of the maintenance record.
5. Schedule and document calibration: The thermocouple calibration interval for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02) is 55 days. Enter next due date in the maintenance management system immediately after completing calibration.
6. Verify data logger operation and confirm logged temperatures match controller output over a test cycle. Attach exported data to the maintenance record as required by SOP-P2-L4-02.
7. Restore power and remove lockout/tagout following SB-1016 procedures. Notify operations per SOP-P2-L4-03.

## Acceptance criteria
- Control readout setpoint is 885 °C and matches documented setpoint for EQ-P2-L4-HT02.
- Thermocouple meets calibration tolerance as recorded; next calibration scheduled per 55 days interval for EQ-P2-L4-HT02.
- No critical defects or safety items outstanding. Maintenance records complete and linked to SOP-P2-L4-02, SOP-P2-L4-03, and SB-1016.
